chunks: Surely the believers and the Jews, Nazareans and the Sabians, whoever believes in God and the Last Day, and whosoever does right, shall have his reward with his Lord and will neither have fear nor regret.
ai.seo_question: Who are the groups mentioned in Surah Al-Baqarah that can attain salvation through faith and good deeds?
ai.summary: This verse, known as the 'Verse of Salvation' (Ayat al-Khilaf), is central to Shia theological discourse on the inclusivity of divine mercy, affirming that sincere monotheism and righteous action transcend specific religious labels. While classical exegetes like Al-Tabarsi and Al-Qummi discuss whether this applies to pre-Islamic communities or remains valid post-Prophet Muhammad, it underscores the principle that ultimate judgment rests with God, who knows the sincerity of the heart. It serves as a foundational text for interfaith respect and the assurance of peace for those who embody true faith.
